name: Special Shekla Tibs
description: Tender prime beef cubes expertly sautéed to sizzling perfection in clarified niter kibbeh (spiced butter) with sweet red onions, garlic, fresh rosemary sprigs, and jalapeno peppers. Served sizzling hot on a traditional Ethiopian charcoal clay pot accompanied by three rolls of 100% pure teff injera, hot awaze dipping sauce, and fresh seneg karia.

name: Traditional Doro Wat Feast
description: Slow-cooked chicken leg marinated in fresh lemon juice and berbere, simmered for hours in a rich onion and spiced kibbeh sauce. Served with hard-boiled eggs and fresh teff injera.

name: Special Kitfo (Lebleb)
description: Finely minced lean beef warmed with spiced butter (niter kibbeh) and mitmita. Served with ayib (cottage cheese) and gomen (collard greens).

name: Wood-Fired Margherita
description: 12-inch crispy thin crust topped with fresh mozzarella, artisan basil leaves, and slow-roasted San Marzano tomato sauce.

name: Addis Smashed Gourmet Burger
description: Double smashed beef patty with melted cheddar, caramelized onions, house pickles, and signature Addis sauce on a toasted brioche bun.

name: Fresh Layered Spris Juice
description: Traditional Ethiopian 500ml fresh fruit smoothie layered with pure avocado, mango, and papaya, served with a lime wedge.
